STINT

The timer outside the Android app

The widget is Stint's to draw, so it is the one choice here: A is the phone dock in a 4×1 row, B a 2×2 square. The status bar chip, notification, tile and shortcut are drawn by Android in its own colors; Stint picks their words. Data is the seeded account's (apps/web/src/mocks/fixtures.ts).
